label: type III restriction-modification system
definition: A restriction-modification system in which an organism possesses a Type III R-M locus encoding Mod-like DNA methyltransferase and Res-like ATP-dependent restriction subunits, including RM_Type_III loci represented by DefenseFinder.
observations: Type III restriction-modification branch under restriction-modification system; distinct from individual Type III Mod and Res proteins, individual DefenseFinder HMM profile rows, the RM_Type_III source key, broader Type I, Type II, Type IIG, and type IV R-M branches, and the broader restriction-modification parent.
